component.name: Fileship
component.summary: Capture, record and upload to your Fileship

description.p: Fileship for Linux is the desktop app of Fileship, the self-hosted file and media management platform. It waits in the system tray and sends what you capture straight to your own server.

ul.li: Screenshots of a region, a window or a whole monitor, annotated while you pick the area
Screen recordings and GIFs with the microphone and system audio
Text capture that reads the text in an area with your server's OCR
Uploads of files and the clipboard, with the link copied right away
Global shortcuts on X11, and through the Global Shortcuts portal on Wayland
A history of everything you captured and uploaded

description.p: Fileship for Linux needs a Fileship server, version 6.0 or newer.
